To: #team-selection
Replying to: [s01]
Cc: @rafael.ortiz, @ewa.bak
Subject: Ustroń lineup — request to reconsider board 2

Dear Mr Wróbel,

Thank you for posting the lineup, and please note that I am raising this only because the submission deadline is Friday.

In your note of 1 October on the selection criteria for Ustroń, you wrote that form in club events will be taken into account and that the coaches of the players will be consulted before the final lineup is confirmed. I was not consulted this time, so I would be grateful if the announced criteria could be applied consistently before the names go to the organisers.

The November FIDE list alone does not reflect Liliana's real strength. The change of -81 comes entirely from the Katowice open in early October, and she played all of her games there while already unwell. At the rapid qualifier on 24 October she scored 5.5 out of 7 — second overall, with wins over Maja and Antoni and a draw with Kacper — while Igor finished on 4 out of 7. She also missed about two weeks of training in October because of health reasons; since her return she has been back to her normal level and her last three lessons were very good.

I have nothing against Igor. He is a good boy and a strong player, and I would be happy to see him on the team. My point concerns the rule, not the person.

My request is therefore modest: Liliana on board 2. If you prefer to keep the order as posted, I would ask for a short practice match, Liliana against Igor, before Friday, so that the decision can be made on the board rather than on the rating list.

Liliana is available for the whole event and I can confirm that her absence from training in October was for health reasons only; she has fully recovered.

As the coaches are copied to this message, I would appreciate your reply before Friday 13 November, so that the final lineup can be submitted on time.

Kind regards,
Oksana Melnyk
